value.credibility_line: Margin guidance arrived well, but FY26 revenue guidance was later cut and landed below the lowered target.

promises.promise: FY26 revenue guidance implied INR4,000 cr after revision
FY27 revenue growth at 2x market growth
FY27 OSAT and PCB revenue target INR450-500 crores
OSAT and PCB units operational by Q3 FY27

narrative_vs_numbers.claim: Aug 2026: sustain EBITDA margin 15.6% with similar or improved FY27 margin
narrative_vs_numbers.reality: Jun 2026 reported EBITDA margin exactly 15.6%; FY27 multi-quarter promise too early to judge.

narrative_vs_numbers.claim: Aug 2026: FY27/FY28 capex about INR300 cr OSAT, INR300 cr PCB, INR250 cr EMS
narrative_vs_numbers.reality: Capex sum INR850 cr; only Mar 2026 fixed assets+CWIP growth supports expansion, quarterly FY27/FY28 spend not provided.

narrative_vs_numbers.claim: Aug 2026: OSAT and PCB units operational by Q3 FY27
narrative_vs_numbers.reality: No delivery data provided; cannot verify operational status from company-level financials.

narrative_vs_numbers.claim: May 2026: EV customer receivables reduced to below INR100 crore
narrative_vs_numbers.reality: No receivable balance is provided, so the specific target cannot be verified from the given numbers.

bull: Mar 2026 EBITDA margin held at 15.9% and PAT rose 24% YoY to INR364 cr.
Aug 2026 management reaffirmed sustained 15.6% EBITDA margin with Q1 FY27 reported at 15.6% margin.
Aug 2026 stated FY27/FY28 capex near INR850 crores; Mar 2026 fixed assets+CWIP grew sharply to INR2,105 cr.
bear: May 2026 guidance cut showed FY26 revenue slipped from INR4,500 cr to INR4,000 cr, ending at INR3,626 cr.
May 2026 FY26 PAT guidance implied worse margin; actual PAT was INR3,639 cr, margin 10.0%.
Mar 2026 cash flow deteriorated: CFO -INR600 cr, FCF -INR1,841 cr, fixed assets+CWIP INR2,105 cr.
